---
title: 'News'
---

## Key dates

- **October 29th, 2026**: Migration of the Campsis suite from the original Calvagone GitHub organization to the dedicated **[campsisverse](https://github.com/campsisverse)** organization.

- **September 15th, 2026**: Package [`campsisnca`](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/campsisnca/index.html) is now available on CRAN!

- **December 1st, 2024**: Release of [Campsisverse](https://github.com/campsisverse/campsisverse), the package manager of the Campsis suite that allows you to install and update all Campsis packages in one go.

- **November 29th, 2024**: Package [campsisqual](https://github.com/campsisverse/campsisqual/) is now open-source on GitHub and can be used to qualify your suite. Check out our section on [Quality](./quality.html).

-   **June 29th, 2023**: Presentation of e-Campsis at the PAGE meeting in A Coruña. Click [here](https://www.page-meeting.org/default.asp?abstract=10493) to see the poster.

-   **June 22nd, 2023**: Release of the first version of e-Campsis free. Try it out by clicking this [link](https://ecampsis.shinyapps.io/free/).

-   **February 17th, 2022**: Packages [`campsis`](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/campsis/index.html) and [`campsismod`](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/campsismod/index.html) are now available on CRAN!

-   **December 1st, 2021**: We are happy to announce that Campsis is now open-source on GitHub. Please check out the content of our latest releases: [`campsis`](https://github.com/campsisverse/campsis/releases) & [`campsismod`](https://github.com/campsisverse/campsismod/releases)
